acceptance_criteria.AC-WF-1: Every Campaign 9 command-level test, profile, benchmark, candidate, review, and closure gate has an immutable attempt record and the workflow validates with zero errors.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BASE-1: The Campaign 8 fingerprint, protected organizer inputs, environment, final matrix, current exact fusion routes, and target profiles are verified before candidate source changes.
acceptance_criteria.AC-CORRECT-1: A retained candidate has zero failed elements with no error, OOM, unauthorized skip, unexpected attention fallback, missing packed-QKV behavior, or missing fused call in direct, exact-row, stress, neighbor, and broader gates.
acceptance_criteria.AC-PERF-1: A retained candidate provides about five-percent reproducible target or model-profile benefit, or a material launch or memory benefit, with timing drift and every cost disclosed.
acceptance_criteria.AC-BOUNDARY-1: Fusion remains exact to measured runtime and model shapes; adjacent shapes, unsupported masks, dtypes, devices, compilation, gradients, and training preserve Campaign 8 behavior.
acceptance_criteria.AC-EVIDENCE-1: Raw samples, accuracy/error totals, latency, memory, attention/fusion/projection counts, profiler events, environment, source hashes, fingerprint, and command wall time bind to the exact candidate.
acceptance_criteria.AC-REVIEW-1: Any surviving candidate receives a provenance, correctness, performance, boundary, memory, maintenance, and devil's-advocate review before integration.
acceptance_criteria.AC-RELEASE-1: Only approved winners remain and final, organizer-default, held-out, source-derived, profile, inherited-route non-regression, test, documentation, workflow, graph, and tree gates are current.
